purpose: Use two new Gemini calls plus local replay of the frozen primary run to isolate output truncation and coordinate drift without starting another provider bakeoff.

design.geometry_source: Replay all three byte-verified baseline responses for each geometry page.

truncation.observation_to_explain: Each target page had two 4096-token finish-reason failures and one much shorter STOP response in the baseline.
truncation.direct_output_budget_confirmation: The 8192-token call returns STOP with more than 4096 candidate tokens.
truncation.stochastic_overgeneration_not_reproduced: The 8192-token call returns STOP with at most 4096 candidate tokens.
truncation.unresolved_but_preserved: The 8192-token call still fails and its response body is preserved privately for inspection.

geometry.observation_to_explain: 399 repetition 2 and 489 repetition 1 had low target-alignment F1 despite stable text.
geometry.coordinate_generation_stochasticity: Target text CER and line count remain stable while pairwise box F1 materially changes between byte-verified repetitions.
geometry.text_or_segmentation_coupling: Low box F1 coincides with changed target text or line count.

raw_response_policy.all_HTTP_200_responses: Preserve privately whether parsing succeeds or fails.

decision.reason: The probe diagnoses mechanisms only; closed-world complete gold is not ready.

limitations: One new call per truncation page cannot estimate a failure probability.
The probe can identify evidence consistent with output-budget truncation but cannot prove hidden model internals.
The geometry diagnosis is limited to the existing three repetitions on two pages.
